Method.name: UnZip
Method.Description: Take a ZipRequest with a File and split it into items including the directory path

Method.name: checkFile
Method.Implementation:
set tSC=$$$OK set cnt=1 set s1=##class(%File).GetFileSize(fnm) set tWaitTime=..WaitTime set xNL=..MaxNumLoopOfDelay Hang:tWaitTime>0 tWaitTime set s2=##class(%File).GetFileSize(fnm) while (s2 > s1) && (cnt<xNL) { set s1=s1 Hang:tWaitTime>0 tWaitTime set s2=##class(%File).GetFileSize(fnm) set cnt=cnt+1 } if cnt >= xNL { Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral,"Could not process the zip fille "_fnm) }
Quit tSC
